name: mycrew-worker
description: Layer 4/5 of the mycrew harness — the second pilot. Hand /worker any piece of work (a fix, a change, a feature, a question) and it adapts: reads the goal (features) and design (architecture), then drives the right mycrew-setup, mycrew-pipeline, and mycrew-tools skills to finish it. Runs inline as /worker or as a native subagent you delegate a whole task to. Built on mycrew-setup + mycrew-pipeline + mycrew-tools.
